subject: Onramp demo — technical handoff from docs quickstart
messages:
From: Alex Zhou <alex@bridgeapps.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: follow-up technical demo after docs quickstart

Hi Sean,

I hit the docs quickstart yesterday and spun up a prototype using the sample app. We're evaluating Redwood for in-product LLM inference (low-latency reranking + embeddings at scale). The quickstart worked well but I have a few integration questions around:
- model variants and auto-fallback rules
- prefix caching for short-lived sessions
- how to set up a private deployment (VPC) for our compliance needs

Would be great to book a short technical demo with an engineer to validate the architecture choices. I'm available next week (Nov 8–10) between 10am–3pm PST.

Attaching the quickstart output I generated and a short README of our constraints.

Thanks,
Alex Zhou\Lead Backend Engineer\BridgeApps
attachment: quickstart-output.txt

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: follow-up technical demo after docs quickstart

Hi Alex — great to see you in the quickstart, and congrats on getting a prototype up. I'm Sean from the onboarding/SDR team — thanks for the details, that helps.

SoojIN (SE) is looped in to run the technical walkthrough. Can you confirm which of these slots works best for you (60 min recommended):
- Tue Nov 8 | 10:00–11:00 PT
- Tue Nov 8 | 13:00–14:00 PT
- Wed Nov 9 | 11:00–12:00 PT

If none of those work, send a few windows and we'll adjust. Also, is Maya (your infra lead) or another engineer likely to join? That will help us focus the agenda.

I can send a calendar invite once you confirm.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher\Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
Book time: https://cal.com/sean-gallagher/60

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: follow-up technical demo after docs quickstart

Hi Alex — Soojin on the SE team. Thanks for sharing the quickstart output — I skimmed it and have a couple targeted items I'd cover during a 60-minute session:
- short architecture review (10–15m)
- walkthrough of routing & fallback (10m)
- caching & KV strategies for session use-cases (15m)
- deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private) + next steps (15m)

If you prefer a deeper integration session (code-level pairing) we can extend to 90m. For prep it would help if you can share: approximate peak queries/sec, payload size distribution, and any regulatory requirements (data residency/encryption).

My available times (PT):
- Tue Nov 8 | 13:00–14:00
- Wed Nov 9 | 11:00–12:00

I can join via Zoom; Sean will handle the calendar.

—SoojIN
Soojin Lee\Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Zhou <alex@bridgeapps.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Li <maya@bridgeapps.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: follow-up technical demo after docs quickstart

Thanks Sean and Soojin — appreciate the quick responses.

We'd like the 13:00–14:00 PT slot on Tue Nov 8, but Maya can't make the 8th and asked if we can move to Wed Nov 9 11:00–12:00 PT instead. That works for me and aligns with Soojin's availability per the note below. Can you set it for Wed Nov 9 11:00–12:00 PT (90 minutes would also be fine if you want to cover deeper integration).

For prep: our expected peak is ~400 qps with median payloads ~1.2KB. We have a EU data residency requirement for a subset of logs and use KMS for key management. I attached a short note on our architecture.

CC'd Maya — she will join from infra.

Cheers,
Alex
